tasks.title: Add per-slot validation-Task handles to HeroConfigurationState
tasks.dod: HeroConfigurationState exposes two independent Task<Void, Never>? handles (weapon-slot, shield-slot); elf_Kit builds clean with 0 new warnings

tasks.title: Cancel-and-replace + merge-on-write in updateSelectedItems
tasks.dod: updateSelectedItems cancels the slot's previous handle before starting a new one, and a completing Task only merges its own changed key(s) onto the live selectedItems when it is still the slot's current handle

tasks.title: Add a controllable fake WeaponValidator test double
tasks.dod: FakeWeaponValidator conforms to WeaponValidator and lets a test choose per-call resolution order deterministically (no Task.sleep/wall-clock timing)

tasks.title: Regression suite for rapid re-selection, cross-slot, cross-hero and neutrality cases
tasks.dod: New tests reproduce and pass: same-slot rapid re-selection (AC-01/03/04), cross-slot rapid re-selection (AC-06), cross-hero independence (AC-05), and single-selection rejection/auto-resolution neutrality (AC-02); full elf_Kit suite passes; swiftlint clean
